text: {"label":"Intraverbals and Verbal Operant Acquisition","definition":"Research on how verbal operants, especially intraverbals, are established and come under stimulus control. It covers emergent verbal responding, echoic and listener training, speech generating devices, and verbal behavior developmental cusps.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike broad overviews of verbal behavior research, this topic studies specific operants and their acquisition. It does not address reducing vocal stereotypy or assessing competing stimuli."}
